text:
nora_martini: Hey team, last mile on the Martini Health pilot. We're using the JS SDK to stream assistant responses and trigger a "lookup_patient" tool. Two items blocking ship: 1) our consumer (FHIR adapter) strictly expects a top-level `patient` object (schema patient.v1). SDK currently emits tool responses wrapped under `tool_response.result`. 2) procurement needs a pilot pricing estimate for ~10 sustained rps, spikes to 70 rps, plus a note on predictable degradation when reserved is exhausted. Also security wants KMS details and an SSO onboarding checklist.

lee_sales: Thanks Nora 44d looping in Rafa (SDK) and Devon (Platform). We can do a 25min sync.

rafa_sdk: Quick background: there are two supported streaming modes (SSE and websocket) and two structured patterns. If you can change the call, use `structured_output_v1:true` with `tool_call_mode:'pass_args'` and the runtime will emit the tool payload as the top-level structured object. Example usage: ```js
await client.chat.stream({
  model: 'redwood-clinical-1',
  structured_output_v1: true,
  tool_call_mode: 'pass_args',
  tools: [lookupPatientTool],
});
```

rafa_sdk: If you cannot change the flow immediately, here's a tiny unwrap middleware you can drop in your stream consumer: ```js
client.on('tool_called', (evt) => {
  const got = evt.tool_response?.result;
  if (got?.patient) return got.patient;
  return evt;
});
```

nora_martini: That middleware looks straightforward. We prefer a long-term fix to emit patient at top-level so our FHIR pipeline doesn't need transformations. Is structured_output_v1 GA?

rafa_sdk: It's stable for general use but we also have an experimental `structured_output_v2` flag that supports direct schema namespaces like `patient.v1` and strict validation at emit-time. It's gated behind a feature flag for hosted orgs. Devon can toggle for your org if ok.

devon_platform: Confirmed: we can enable `structured_output_v2` per-org via feature flag for pilots. Note on KMS: BYOK (HSM) is supported only on Dedicated/Private. For Hosted pilots we provide managed keys; we can produce an attestation for key handling. IP allowlist is available with an addendum.

ci-bot: deploy 2026-03-21 09:14 UTC: feature flag `structured_output_v2` rolled to staging and can be enabled per-org.

tina_security: From security: we'll need a short artifact pack for PoC containing: SAML SP-initiated docs, SCIM provisioning example, encryption at rest details, audit log sample, and data residency info. Also include a short threat model for tool calls (what executes when a tool returns JSON that maps to internal IDs). I can send a checklist.

lee_sales: Pricing quick calc: 10 rps sustained at ~700 tokens/request => ~0.6M tokens/day. With bursts to 70 rps we plan for capacity headroom. Initial recommended pilot commit: small Dedicated equivalent (2x A100) to keep latency predictable and allow burst routing. Ballpark: $15k-$25k/mo depending on model footprint and burst hours. I'll request a firm quote.

nora_martini: Good enough for procurement to move forward. Can you also confirm how fallback works if the dedicated pool is saturated? We need graceful degradation (cached prefix, smaller model), not hard errors.

devon_platform: Yes: configure route policy with `fallback_behavior: 'graceful'` to do prefix cache or route to a lower-tier hosted model. Example snippet: ```yaml
routes:
  - name: martini-pilot
    primary: dedicated/martini-pilot
    fallback: hosted-small
    fallback_behavior: graceful
```

devon_platform: Also enable `prefix_kv_cache: true` for repeat queries to reduce token usage and improve tail behavior.

rafa_sdk: One gotcha: when using websockets, ensure your client applies the middleware to the `message` event and handles partial chunks. SSE consumers will already get structured events when `structured_output_v1` is used.

lee_sales: Action items: 1) Rafa to enable `structured_output_v2` flag for Nora's org and run a short test with them (link: https://meet.redwood.internal/martini-poc) 2) Devon to confirm KMS attestation steps and IP addendum path 3) Tina to send security PoC checklist 4) Sales to get a formal pilot pricing PDF.

nora_martini: Thanks all. Please add me to the presales ticket and ping when flag is enabled. We'll plan to use the unwrap middleware only until the flag is live. :thumbsup:
